title: Kaboom Crew ragdoll migration — replace S105 procedural-spring DeathAnim with the new engine physics ragdoll module
intent: Once `GDP-2026-05-24-001` ships the engine ragdoll module, port Kaboom Crew off the S105-shipped procedural-spring ragdoll. The procedural path lives entirely inside `examples/kaboom-crew/src/` and is therefore in the wrong place (per CLAUDE.md engine/project split). Migration: register a `kaboom-bomber` RagdollTemplate at bootstrap, replace the DeathAnim system's spring math + S108 ground-clamp + S108 wall-collision with a single `RagdollSpawnRequest` on alive=false flip + an impulse vector derived from the blast direction. The visual result should be at-least-as-good as today (likely better — real physics handles ground + walls + chain reactions natively). Pure code-relocation + behaviour upgrade. Zero gameplay impact.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/ragdoll-module-design.md §9` (Kaboom Crew first-consumer mapping with full body + joint table) + memory [project-ragdoll-physics-module] (decision pivot). Depends on GDP-2026-05-24-001 — that ships the module + API surface this story consumes. The S105 spring path is presentationally fine but lives in the wrong codebase location; this migration moves the implementation under engine/physics/ragdoll/ where every future humanoid game benefits. Reduces examples/kaboom-crew/src/ by ~3 files (death-animation-system spring math, S108 ground-clamp helper, S108 wall-collision helper) — net deletion locally + net addition in engine.
acceptanceHints: Depends on GDP-2026-05-24-001 (engine ragdoll module shipped + registered).
READ FIRST: `docs/game-design/ragdoll-module-design.md §9` — the canonical kaboom-bomber template (10 bodies + 9 joints with mass + dimensions + limits) is fully specified there.
NEW FILE: examples/kaboom-crew/src/characters/kaboom-bomber-ragdoll-template.ts:
exports `KABOOM_BOMBER_RAGDOLL: RagdollTemplate`
bodies[] populated from the table in ragdoll-module-design.md §9 (mass-balanced; total ~1.0)
joints[] populated from the same — 1 neck (spherical), 2 shoulders (spherical), 2 elbows (revolute), 2 hips (spherical), 2 knees (revolute) = 9 total
defaults: { linearDamping: 0.4, angularDamping: 0.6 }
BOOTSTRAP REGISTRATION (examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts): on init, call `registerRagdollTemplate('kaboom-bomber', KABOOM_BOMBER_RAGDOLL)`. One call, one line.

SKELETAL BINDING: when the bomber tree spawner creates the 10 visible meshes from S102, write `SkeletalBinding { bodyName: 'torso' | 'head' | ... }` on each mesh entity. The engine spawn system reads this at ragdoll-time to know which mesh re-parents to which body. Naming MUST match the template's body names — that's the contract.
DEATH SYSTEM REWORK (examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/death-animation-system.ts):

On BomberStats.alive false-flip: read the killing blast's origin cell (from the BlastEvent's payload or the existing on-bomber RagdollState capture component — same as S105 path); compute direction vector (target - origin, normalized) + magnitude (clamp 1.0..4.0 per chain count); write `RagdollSpawnRequest { templateKey: 'kaboom-bomber', impulse: { linear: direction × 2.5, angular: cross(direction, worldUp) × π } }` on the bomber root.
All the S105 spring-math (limb flail per-pivot impulse, integrated spring updates) is REMOVED. The engine RagdollSpawnSystem handles the rest.
REMOVE the S108 ground-clamp helper + S108 wall-collision helper — Rapier's native arena-floor + arena-wall colliders handle both. Document the removal in the PR description.
DESPAWN TIMING: 0.6 s after alive-flip (same as today), the bomber root entity is despawned. The engine teardown system cascades — disposes ragdoll bodies + joints. No leak.

MULTIPLAYER (forward-compat — once GDP-022-011 Sprint B lands): on the receiving client, when the snapshot's `bomberDied` event arrives, fire the SAME RagdollSpawnRequest path with the blast origin from the snapshot. Server doesn't simulate ragdoll — clients run their own. Visual drift between tabs is acceptable per gameplay-systems.md §12.1.
GAMEPLAY INVARIANTS — all preserved:
alive=false flip frame: unchanged.
GridOccupancy clear: unchanged.
RoundResolveSystem trigger: unchanged.
Auto-restart 3 s: unchanged.
Hit-recoil (GDP-006, shipped S109) still fires on the bomber's torso CHILD for shielded hits; ragdoll is a separate ROOT-level animation. No conflict.

DETERMINISM: bot-vs-bot.test.ts continues to resolve within budget. Server-side gameplay (which doesn't run ragdolls anyway) is unaffected. Visual replay may differ; gameplay state matches frame-for-frame.
VISUAL QA (manual, after merge):
Trigger a death from the east → bomber tumbles westward (limbs flail, body lands ~0.7 cells from death cell).
Self-bomb death → pure vertical launch with limp flail.
Chain-reaction (2+ blasts same frame) → more dramatic launch but stays in arena.

Compare side-by-side with S105 spring version — readability should be EQUAL OR BETTER. If worse, tuning levers are in the template's mass/damping/joint-limit fields, NOT in death-animation-system code.
PERF: per-bomber Rapier cost = 10 bodies + 9 joints during the 0.6 s ragdoll window. 4 simultaneous deaths = 40 bodies + 36 joints peak. Well within physics-bench's 200-body envelope.

gameplay-systems.md §2.3 ragdoll bullet — point at the new engine module location
examples/kaboom-crew/README.md — note that death uses engine ragdoll module
OUT OF SCOPE:
Per-recipe ragdoll variation (heavier bombers tumble slower). Future possibility via per-bomber template override; not v1.
Ragdoll-pose-aware death audio (e.g. additional impact thuds when limbs hit floor). Existing single death audio event stays.
Ragdoll-as-physics-prop (other bombers bumping into a dead body). Collision group already excludes this; do not add it.
Reverse-from-ragdoll (revive). No use case in Kaboom Crew.
